caption: On a white tabletop, two blurred magnetic-ball structures sit in the background—a plain silver sphere on the left and a sphere lit with green LEDs on the right. In the foreground a small silver cube magnet rests beside a strip of rectangular magnets, with a mound of blue granular material at the strip's near end, while fingertips hover at the left edge. The cube tilts and rotates in place before sliding rightward to reach the blue mound and the end of the strip. As the cube makes contact, the blue material lifts into standing spike-like tufts around the cube and the strip's tip. Those tufts then unfurl outward into a broad curved fan of blue bristles that drapes along the magnet strip. The fan holds its shape, slowly flattening and spreading a little further as the cube stays embedded at the near end, the strip itself remaining fixed. Toward the left the fingertips gradually withdraw out of frame.
relations: The cube magnet can tilt, rotate, and slide right toward the blue mound at the strip end.
When the cube touches the blue granules, the granules can lift into spiked tufts around it.
Those tufts can unfurl outward into a curved fan that drapes along the fixed magnet strip.
The fan can slowly flatten and spread while the cube remains embedded and fingertips withdraw left.
